templates.name: products-listing
templates.description: Product category and equipment-type listing pages (61). One white main section (no section style): page H1 (inside the Featured product-list richtext on 49 pages; in a standalone top-level richtext on 10 pages without the carousel; in a title component on 2 pages without the carousel), optional "Featured Products" label + carousel, category sibling-link nav (Filter toggle/panel, mobile scroll-menu, "See all" toggles and "Back to all products" links are cleanup-removed), then grouped product grids each preceded by its group heading. Both the Featured carousel and every product group grid map to the single block variant cards-products (grid is a block option, not a separate variant). Instance .product-list__rebrand .slider-wrapper is the carousel and must emit the plain "Cards-Products" header; instance .pll .product-listing-list__category-container__items is a group grid and the parser must detect it (element.matches('.product-listing-list__category-container__items') / contains .product-listing-item) and call WebImporter.Blocks.createBlock(document, { name: 'cards-products', variants: ['grid'], cells }) so the header renders "Cards-Products (grid)". Carousel DOM: a.slide > .teaser-image (img in rendered DOM, data-bg on raw HTML) + .product-title + .category-heading .inner__description (skip .slick-cloned slides). Grid DOM: .product-listing-item > .product-listing-item__img-container (optional __isologo ISOCLEAN badge img + __product img) + .product-listing-item__title-link + .product-listing-item__benefits label + .product-listing-item__benefits-container ul + .product-listing-category__more a (Learn More) + .product-listing-category__buyonline a (button).

sections.name: Product listing main content

templates.name: expertise-marketing
templates.description: Our Expertise brand/marketing pages (28) built from AEM components (multi-column, richtext, title, cmp-image, carousels, accordion-text, drawer, testimonial, simple-panel, panel-with-button, distributor, social-media, knowledge-center, product-list). Every top-level component under #main-content > .container-fluid maps to exactly one block variant, default content, or is excluded - verified on all 28 live pages (see migration-work/expertise/mapping-coverage.json). multi-column instances are told apart by item structure only (no :nth-child/:nth-of-type): nested icon|text multi-column per item = cards-service; image-only item beside text item = columns-media; items of image + richtext + (richtext|button|video) = cards-resource; image + single label = cards-service; image-only items = columns-promo; button-only / social-icon (column16) / link-icon (column20) items = columns-cta. multi-columns nested in a multi-column item or a drawer are never block instances. simple-panel is a container (children mapped individually) except image+richtext+button-only panels = hero-callout. Parser branches (see mapping-coverage.json notes): quote-testimonial on the delo bg-blue video multi-column uses item 1 as the quote and leaves item 2 as default content; cards-resource splits items into one card per cmp-image group, splits text-only product columns at .divider, handles text-before-image items and adds blue-caption when the caption richtext__container has bg-isoclean; columns-media takes the image/video item as cell 1 regardless of order and skips spacer items; cards-service handles nested and flat tiles; columns-cta handles social-media, panel-with-button, button rows, icon-link rows and the richtext link row (option links); accordion-faq adds load-more when a.btn is present; hero-overlay handles richtext and button overlays. Sections: generic bands derived from bg classes per migration-work/expertise/section-rules.json (sections[] below documents the band types; the sections transformer must group consecutive top-level components by computed band style instead of using one selector per section).

blocks.name: columns-cta
instances: #main-content > .container-fluid > .richtext:has(> .richtext__container > div > p > a ~ a ~ a ~ a ~ a)

sections.name: Unstyled band (white / transparent background): every top-level component whose band element has bg-white, bg-transparent, defaultBackground or no bg token; consecutive ones form one section ("centered" appended when all its default content is centre-aligned)
Light grey band (#f5f5f5): bg-light-gray on the band element, plus the testimonial container
Product carousel band (linear-gradient #f5f5f5 to white)
ISOCLEAN sky blue band (#04a2d3): bg-isoclean
Delo cobalt blue band (#0066b2): bg-blue / bg-delo
Chevron blue band (#0c2e72): bg-strong-blue, and panel-with-button defaultBackground (#0b2d71)
Black band (#000): bg-black
Teal blue band (#017da4): bg-blue-2 (greaseportfolio filter row only; needs a section style in styles.css)
